title.en: The buyer’s check on this page is off-grid, is Diesel 50 the Electric 50 replacement
title.zh: 本页要核对的是：无电网时，柴油50是电动50的替代吗

description.en: Taken from the printed row: It is the diesel model to open in that class, not a copy of Electric 50. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 50 for sites without stable grid power: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m and 3300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 50 is 55 kW, 26 m³/h, with fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm 60 m / 180 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. The selection guide places both on medium projects and tells you to match power type first.
description.zh: 它是这一档要打开的柴油型号，不是电动50的复印件。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油50印给电网不便的工地：6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m、3300 kg。电动50是 55 kW、26 m³/h，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 80 m / 240 m，24 mm 60 m / 180 m。选型指南把两台都放在中型项目上，并要求先对照动力。

body.en: “Concrete plant” breaks its subject at “Types”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Only as the diesel row in that output class: 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 150 m / 450 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 50 for sites without stable grid power: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m and 3300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 50 prints three stone distances. Keep this cell as published. Ask Xingtai, or look at a diesel page that does print a coarse limit, such as LZ-80 at 6 cm and below, if the rest of that table also fits. Taken from the printed row: That shared hopper does not merge the pumps. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes, on Diesel 50. Keep this cell as published. Diesel spraying machines are separate products with their own m³/h and hose cells. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant
body.zh: 《Concrete plant》在“类型”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：只是同一档输送量里的柴油行：99 kW、30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。它不继承电动50的三行石子。按邢台表上的原文理解：输送量是不同的格子。料斗都是 0.4 m³。共用料斗不会把两台泵合并。柴油50重 3300 kg，电动50重 2800 kg。旁边那一台不在这句话里。是，在柴油50上。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant

body.en: Borrow “Application” from “Concrete plant” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. It does not inherit Electric 50’s three stone rows. Taken from the printed row: Electric 50 is 55 kW, 26 m³/h, with fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm 60 m / 180 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 50’s introduction pairs its single distance with 1 cm aggregate and the specification list has no maximum-aggregate cell. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The outputs are different cells. Keep this cell as published. Weight is 3300 kg on Diesel 50 and 2800 kg on Electric 50. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. No.
body.zh: 把《Concrete plant》的“用途”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：它是这一档要打开的柴油型号，不是电动50的复印件。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油50印给电网不便的工地：6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m、3300 kg。电动50是 55 kW、26 m³/h，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 80 m / 240 m，24 mm 60 m / 180 m。选型指南把两台都放在中型项目上，并要求先对照动力。目录里已经写着：请写“无电网”，以及你能提供依据的石子标注。按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。

body.en: The reference page “Concrete plant” uses “Dust and water pollution” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is the diesel model to open in that class, not a copy of Electric 50. Keep this cell as published. The selection guide places both on medium projects and tells you to match power type first. Taken from the printed row: A 24 mm off-grid mix is not answered by silence. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hopper volume is 0.4 m³ on both. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Write “no grid” and the stone label you can document. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 来源页《Concrete plant》用“粉尘和水污染”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动50印了三行石子距离。柴油50的介绍把唯一的距离和 1 cm 骨料写在一起，规格表没有最大骨料格。24 mm 的无电网料不能用空白来回答。问邢台，或者去看确实印了粗骨料上限的柴油页，例如 LZ-80 的 6 cm 及以下，前提是那张表的其余格子也对。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。目录里已经写着：不是。柴油喷涂机是单独的产品，有自己的 m³/h 和软管格。

question.en: Is the engine 6105 / 99 kW, once the outline says “Types”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“类型”时，发动机是 6105 / 99 kW 吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Yes, on Diesel 50.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：是，在柴油50上。

question.en: Under “Application”, does Diesel 50 print a 13 mm row?
question.zh: 在“用途”这一节里，柴油50印了 13 mm 行吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：没有。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Dust and water pollution” — Is this a spraying diesel?
question.zh: “粉尘和水污染”旁边仍要印着的是什么：这是喷涂用柴油机吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Diesel spraying machines are separate products with their own m³/h and hose cells.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。柴油喷涂机是单独的产品，有自己的 m³/h 和软管格。
